00-aujourdhui: Today, we're learning the letter k.
02-regarde: Watch how we write the k.
03-depart: We start on the green dot. We go up in a curve, and we make a big loop to the LEFT, right at the top. We come straight back down to the line. Then we go back UP along the SAME line, without lifting the pencil, and we make a small loop to the RIGHT. It comes back to touch the line, and the leg goes down: an arch, then a curve resting on the line.
04-encore: One more time, a little faster.
05-cherchons: Now, let's find words that begin with k.
10-pareil: Did you hear? They all begin the same way.
11-relance: Find a word that begins with k.
